name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
title: Firstsource Solutions Ltd - 532809 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4FY26 CC growth 11.6% YoY with a 3% QoQ rise, EBIT margin 12.2%, and FY27 guided to 10–13% CC growth and 12.25–12.75% EBIT; a BPO with no supply-side capacity signals, so the read rests on demand and margin.

triggers.label: Q4 CMT degrew 4% QoQ
triggers.quote: revenues grew 3% YoY but degrew 4% on a QoQ basis

triggers.label: Diverse portfolio degrew 8% QoQ
triggers.quote: degrew 8% quarter-on-quarter in constant currency terms

triggers.label: FY27 CC growth guided 10–13%
triggers.quote: we are guiding to constant currency growth for FY27 to be in the 10% to 13% range

triggers.label: Deal pipeline above $1bn, highest ever
triggers.quote: our deal pipeline has stayed above a billion dollars and in fact is at its highest ever level

guidance.quote: we are guiding to constant currency growth for FY27 to be in the 10% to 13% range
we are guiding for EBIT margin band of 12.25% to 12.75% for FY27

guidance.value: 14% to 15% band in the next couple of years
guidance.quote: we remain laser-focused on taking our EBIT margin to 14% to 15% band in the next couple of years

prior_guidance_check.quote: EBIT margin of 11.7%, within the 11.5% to 12% range we have guided previously
the effective tax rate was 20.6%, within the previously guided range of 19% to 21%

prior_guidance_check.metric: Billion-dollar revenue run rate by Q4 FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: we actually crossed that in Q4 of FY25

red_flags.label: Q4 timing slippage pushed revenue into Q1 FY27
red_flags.quote: it's not that the revenue is gone, but rather it's deferred or delayed by a quarter itself

red_flags.label: Net debt up to INR16.3bn from INR13.2bn
red_flags.quote: Our net debt stood at INR16.3 billion as of 31st March 2026 versus the INR13.2 billion as of 31st March 2025

evasions.quote: we don't comment on specific deals itself, you know, in terms of where they are at or so on and so forth
